explanation:
The central tree shrinks from 93 to 56 lines (39.8%) and from 7,319 to 4,488 characters (38.7%). Five peripherals expand selection decisions, mapping identity, filesystem boundaries, definition mechanisms and inspection state. [M] means modular structure, [C] calls, [O] ownership and [D] data dependency. Following the critique, definition validation and session mechanics have their primary explanation in lsp; the central tree retains the contract. Peripherals sit beside their corresponding branches. All edge endpoints and text bounds were checked; rectangles do not overlap.

Evidence is limited to the supplied point and pinned sources. diagramSource.ts supports binding selection; codePanel.ts supports mapping identity and ordering; corpus.ts and projectSource.ts support reads and hashes; projectLanguageService.ts supports lookup and lifetime; the two UI files support inspection behavior. Details absent from the seed include compatible binding replacement, hash-sensitive resource identity, adjacent ranges remaining separate, keyboard navigation and the greater-than-240-row deferral threshold.

Corrections and qualifications: multi-line navigation selects only the destination's first line, subject to activation/restoration guards. UTF-16 initialization accepts an omitted server encoding but rejects a different declared encoding. Session sharing is scoped to a service instance and canonical root. Returned definition targets receive path filtering, not the corpus provider's filesystem checks. Supplied graph comments do not establish recorded execution.

The collection-wide reconciliation recommendation cannot establish additional facts here: other points' implementations are outside the permitted evidence. Only the supplied relationships support textual pointers to diagrams and storage. Imported helper internals and UI-to-service wiring remain unverified. Rendered connector routing and interactions were not assessed.

diagrams.ascii:
Source Evidence and Navigation
|-- [M] Explicit repository selection: resolveDiagramSource
|   |-- Input: project + optional representation/revision/content/source IDs
|   |   `-- Optional live diagram participates in the same identity checks
|   |-- [C] Load project -> validate identity -> select a diagram or registered source
|   |   |-- Live diagram: validate content; saved representation: select one diagram
|   |   `-- Source-only request: require one distinct registered source identity
|   |-- [D] Selected diagram -> source query + explicit repository binding
|   |   `-- Project identity alone does not establish a repository
|   `-- Exposes binding(), readText(), listFiles() alongside query and diagram
|       `-- Access closures require both a binding and injected CorpusAccess
|-- [M] Mapped evidence: domain selection handlers -> PanelContent
|   |-- [D] Diagram content + selected nodes + mappings -> source-range resources
|   |   |-- Reject mappings whose content hash differs from the diagram's ASCII hash
|   |   `-- Coordinates carry project/source identity, path and inclusive one-based lines
|   |-- [C] handleNodeSelect -> resolveSelectedNodes -> resolveNodeResources
|   |   `-- Selection follows diagram line/column order; unresolved IDs remain visible
|   |-- [D] Resource identity includes the hash of stored original range text
|   |   `-- Combined resources retain selected-node and mapped-node provenance
|   |-- PanelContent retains diagram/revision/hash, selected IDs and unmapped IDs
|   `-- buildSourceRangeDisplayModel -> ordered file sections with contributing items
|       `-- Grouping preserves diagram order rather than globally sorting source lines
|-- [M] Source access: ProjectSourceService -> binding resolver -> corpus provider
|   |-- files(project, directory, sourceId) -> resolved listFiles(directory)
|   |-- source(project, path, sourceId) -> resolved readText(path)
|   |   |-- Missing path or NUL-containing text -> error instead of a source preview
|   |   `-- [D] Result: path, startLine: 1, lines, sourceSha256 and lspEnabled
|   |       `-- Whole-text hash accompanies displayed lines for definition freshness
|   |-- [M] Corpus providers expose bounded repository-relative file access
|   |   |-- Both git-worktree and filesystem-documents use filesystem reads
|   |   |-- Public operations: listDirectory, readLines, readDocumentLines/Text/Bytes
|   |   `-- Private resolution checks canonical root, path segments and target type
|   `-- [D] Range reads validate one-based bounds and clip at the document's end
|       `-- Stored range hashes and current whole-file hashes describe different inputs
|-- [M] Definition navigation: optional LanguageService behind ProjectSourceService
|   |-- definitions(reference, path, position, sourceSha256, signal) resolves binding
|   |   `-- [C] Delegates to language.definitions(binding.corpus, ...)
|   |-- [D] Requires current matching text; returns locations plus outsideRoot count
|   |-- [O] ProjectLanguageService owns reusable sessions per canonical root
|   `-- Disabled service rejects lookup; detailed validation and lifetime live in lsp
`-- [M] Source inspection: repository browser and read-only source viewer
    |-- RepositoryFileExplorer consumes CodeRepoService and emits onOpen(path)
    |   |-- [C] Expanded directories request listings; file clicks emit the chosen path
    |   |-- [O] Service-scoped listing promises are shared between explorer instances
    |   `-- Directory instances retain their own expansion and subscription state
    `-- SourceCodeView consumes preview, range, presentation and optional navigation
        |-- [D] Preview lines + path + theme -> tokens with original-text fallback
        |   `-- Lines + highlights + annotations + compaction metadata -> rendered rows
        |-- Fold controls reveal whole sections or supplied graph-node source lines
        |   `-- Graph comments are supplied metadata, not a measured execution trace
        |-- [C] Ctrl/Meta-click or F12 -> source position -> onGoToDefinition callback
        |   `-- Callback is optional; service wiring is outside the pinned source
        |-- Navigation props control expansion, scrolling and destination selection
        |   `-- Multi-line destination selection covers only its first source line
        |-- [O] Viewer owns token/fold state; scrollState can retain viewport offsets
        `-- Large unwrapped views may defer offscreen work while retaining the DOM

Binding selection decisions
|-- [C] representationId supplied -> load catalog before live/saved choice
|   `-- revisionId ?? currentRevisionId must belong to that representation
|-- Live branch -> validateDiagram; check requested contentId
|-- Saved branch -> sceneFromRevision -> filter contents
|   `-- Match contentId, or source-bound contents if absent; require one
|-- Source-only branch -> catalog bindings, then project.sources
|   |-- Filter by requested sourceId; collect in a Map keyed by sourceId
|   |-- Same ID but different corpus root/kind/repositoryIdentity -> error
|   |-- Compatible later binding replaces earlier binding
|   `-- One distinct source -> synthetic source-query diagram
|-- [D] Requested sourceId must match the selected diagram's binding
|   `-- binding() rejects a selected diagram without a repository
`-- [M] Catalog reads mark the handoff to related point: storage
    `-- Pinned code shows reads; catalog implementation is not supplied

Mapping identity and ordered display
|-- [D] sourceRangeIndex skips entries missing a mapped node/entity/range
|   |-- sourceId = entity.sourceId ?? binding?.sourceId ?? empty string
|   `-- rangeSha256 = SHA-256(originalLines joined with LF)
|       `-- Stored evidence is hashed here; disk is not reread
|-- [D] sourceResourceIdentity includes type + project/source + path
|   `-- Also start/end lines + range hash: changed hashes remain distinct
|-- [C] resolveNodeResources returns matches and unmapped node IDs
|   |-- Matches supply selected/mapped nodes for origin labels
|   `-- Combining identical resources appends origins; selected IDs dedupe
|-- [C] buildSourceRangeDisplayModel compares only the last file/range
|   |-- Different project/source/path OR earlier start -> new file section
|   |-- Otherwise start <= previous end -> extend end; retain both items
|   `-- Otherwise append a range; immediately adjacent ranges stay separate
`-- [M] mappedResourceHandlers exposes index/identity/buildDisplayModel
    |-- Computation has no React or file I/O dependency
    `-- Mapping-query boundary: related point diagrams; helpers unshown

Filesystem access checks
|-- [C] realpath(binding.root) -> require matching kind and directory
|-- Relative-path parser rejects absolute paths, backslashes and NUL
|   |-- Reject empty segments, '.' and '..'; empty whole path means root
|   `-- Walk segments with lstat; reject missing paths and symlinks
|-- Require containment beneath canonical root and correct final type
|   `-- Root itself may resolve through a link; checked segments may not
|-- [D] listDirectory hides .git and classifies symlink entries as files
|   |-- A listed symlink still cannot be read through this provider
|   `-- Sort directories first, then case-insensitive name, then path
|-- [C] readDocumentBytes -> readFile -> UTF-8 decode for text
|   `-- Document lines split CRLF/LF; range reads slice start - 1 to end
|       `-- Bounds: integer start >= 1, end >= start; clip at line count
`-- [D] ProjectSourceService hashes decoded full text before returning lines
    `-- The LSP freshness check rehashes a new read of that full text

Definition validation and session mechanisms
|-- [D] Before lookup: require repository path and supported TS/JS file
|   |-- Position must contain nonnegative integer line/character
|   |-- Read via corpusProvider -> SHA-256 must match displayed source
|   `-- Line must exist; character may equal line.length
|-- [O] Instance Map<canonical root, session>: replace missing/dead entry
|   `-- Private session owns child process, RPC, serial queue and timers
|-- [C] Initialize: require definition provider; advertise UTF-16
|   |-- Omitted server encoding accepted; different declared encoding rejected
|   `-- workspace/applyEdit -> applied: false
|-- [C] Queue -> await ready -> check dead/abort -> didOpen(verified text)
|   |-- Definition request uses an AbortSignal-backed cancellation token
|   |-- Finally: remove listener, dispose token, didClose if alive
|   |   `-- Outer finally schedules idle disposal
|   `-- Catch rejected queue tail so later requests can proceed
|-- [D] Normalize single result or array
|   |-- Prefer targetUri over uri; targetSelectionRange over range
|   |-- Non-file URI or rejected repository-relative path -> outsideRoot++
|   |-- Deduplicate serialized path + range
|   `-- Returned targets are not reread or realpath-checked here
`-- [O] Disposal: idempotent; unregister live session, clear timer/RPC
    |-- Initialize/request timeout: 20 seconds; idle timeout: five minutes
    |-- RPC error and child error/exit also dispose the session
    |-- Terminate child PID on Windows, process group elsewhere
    |-- Service dispose clears map and removes process-exit listener
    `-- Process exit disposes service; SIGINT/SIGTERM dispose live sessions

Inspection state and interaction details
|-- [O] Explorer cache: WeakMap<CodeRepoService, Map<key, promise>>
|   |-- Key = project/source/directory; over 256 entries evict oldest
|   |-- Rejection evicts only if the cached promise is still that request
|   |-- Refresh clears project keys across sources; reloads this explorer
|   `-- Directory cleanup ignores late results; shared request continues
|-- [C] Explorer keys operate on visible file/directory buttons
|   |-- Up/Down: adjacent; Home/End: first/last; Right: expand
|   `-- Left: collapse expanded directory, otherwise focus parent
|-- [D] Viewer accepts valid collapsed sections wholly inside preview
|   |-- Annotations precede lines; highlightedRanges overrides range
|   |-- Plain presentation skips tokenization; obsolete results ignored
|   `-- Graph-node source lines are clipped to the supplied preview
|-- [O] Source/compaction/navigation changes reset graph-node expansion
|   `-- Section expansion resets to sections containing navigation start
|-- [C] active=false skips restoration and destination-selection effects
|   |-- New source identity: prefer scrollState.read(), then initial offset
|   |   `-- Restored offset returns before ordinary scroll/selection
|   |-- Otherwise scroll targetLine or range.startLine near upper fifth
|   `-- Selection receives start.line + 1 and an end on that same line
|       `-- Reapply after tokenization when active and no initial offset
|-- [O] Hidden viewer contributes no retained offset through connect()
|   `-- Ignore zero/zero scroll events when the viewer has no CSS box
`-- [O] Offscreen deferral requires enabled, unwrapped, >240 rendered rows
    |-- Keep DOM in chunks of 80 for native search and selection
    |-- Measure dimensions before setting contentVisibility=auto
    `-- ResizeObserver remeasures width changes; disconnect on cleanup
